restatement_groups.reason: Both require an approval mark to be affixed to every vehicle conforming to a type approved under UN R10. R-0002 cites paragraph 5.3, which is the R-0004 clause; R-0004 adds only where the mark goes.
Both require the emission of transient conducted disturbances from the ESA on 12/24 V supply lines to be tested or measured according to ISO 7637-2 (Annex 10).
